name: Masfen Enerji Anonim Sirketi
summary: Masfen Enerji Anonim Sirketi operates as a renewable energy solutions provider in Turkey and Europe. The company offers turnkey solar energy solutions, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar power plant projects, operation and maintenance services, solar tracking systems (MasTrack), energy storage solutions (MastekShield), and financial solutions. It serves diverse sectors such as tourism, agriculture, and manufacturing in Turkey and Europe. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Isparta, Turkey.
